answer: Resist sybils by giving each identity one unshareable thread of sequential work: each step hashes the last, so n clones need n full threads in real time — wall-clock cost cannot be pooled. Influence grows only as the square root of bonded stake, so splitting stake shrinks total voice. Identities join a willow grove with entangled bonds: hidden umber audits plant decoy tasks, and when one member is caught, every bond in its willow is slashed by the square of the grove size. Cloning thus costs faster than n while paying less.
